spec.assertion: Structural: a dot effect (durationSec 5, intervalSec 1) whose carrier block expresses the 25% rate as everyN/hitCount 4 OR a rate-scaled 4.32% tick. Behavioural: zeroing the dot atkPct lowers harran's total, doubling it raises it by the same magnitude (linearity). Fails under the nearest-wrong ungated every-shot 17.28% DoT (explicitly asserted absent — a 4x over-credit) and under a missing/inert S1.

spec.kitLine: 17.28% final ATK every 1 sec for 5 sec
spec.assertion: durationSec === 5 and intervalSec (default) === 1 on every dot effect. Fails under a fight-length continuous DoT instance (the taxonomy's DoT-encoding trap) or a wall-clock/interval mismatch.
it.skip — scope lock is one partless immortal boss with no adds; no kill event exists in the engine, so the line is unobservable and correctly contributes zero.

spec.kitLine: on Full Charge attack, affects self
spec.assertion: Trigger identity: a per-full-charge self grant, verified indirectly by the presence of repeated buffApply events with targetSlug harran across the fight (not a single cast-time application). Fails if keyed to burstCast/fullBurstEnter, which would emit only a handful of applications.

buffApply stat critRatePct value 2.95 with durationShots === 1 and targetSlug harran; plus zeroing it lowers total (non-vacuity). Fails under the nearest-wrong durationSec:1 (round-vs-second confusion), under critRateNormalPct (wrongly scoped — asserted absent), and under a team-wide grant (teammate inertness).

Live: pierce is expressed somehow (top-level hasPierce, slot hasPierce, or a gainPierce effect). it.skip documents that no primitive expresses a ROUND-scoped pierce window — gainPierce takes durationSec only and hasPierce is whole-fight.

Enforced inertness: ZERO buffApply events with stat atkPct value 3.02, and no block carrying that buff may sit on a passive trigger. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'model the stacks as an always-on passive', which would silently hand harran up to +45.3% ATK in a fight where nothing dies.

Structural: exactly one burst-slot flatDamage, atkPct 999, core falsy (the prose never says core strike), trigger burstCast. Behavioural: zero/half/full atkPct counterfactuals give a strictly monotone total with the half-delta between 0.4x and 0.6x of the full delta, proving atkPct is the true magnitude source.

Counterfactual: re-keying the same nuke to fullBurstEnter produces a STRICTLY higher total, proving the shipped model does not take the +50% Full Burst major — consistent with the verified fact that burst-cast damage lands before the FB window opens.
Single-boss scope: exactly one flatDamage instance (not a multi-target fan-out). A per-enemy duplication would show as >1 flatDamage effect in the burst slot.

fixtures: controlComp('harran', true) for all 7 runs — liter B1 + crown B2 supply the burst chain so the Burst III carry actually casts (a lone B3 makes ZERO full bursts, which would make every burst, FB-exemption and full-charge assertion vacuous); the fixed B3 slot is kept because harran's kit grants nothing to allies and reads nothing from them, so it cannot confound her readings. Deterministic (no seed). Runs: base (event-collecting) + burst atkPct x0 / x0.5 + burst re-keyed to fullBurstEnter + dot atkPct x0 / x2 + crit buff value 0. All counterfactuals are built with withPatchedOverride and locate their targets by EFFECT KIND, never by block index, so a differently-structured-but-faithful override still passes.
gaps: S1b 'Activates when an enemy afflicted with Virus Transfer is neutralized. Affects 2 nearest enemy unit(s)' — it.skip: scope lock is a single partless immortal boss with no adds; the engine models no enemy entity and emits no kill event, so the spread is unobservable and contributes zero.

S2a 'Gain Pierce for 1 round(s)' — it.skip: no primitive expresses a ROUND-scoped pierce window (gainPierce carries durationSec only; hasPierce is a whole-fight boolean). Both available encodings are approximations; the residual is unobservable at scope lock because pierce only matters through a Pierce Damage buff, which no control-comp member carries.

S2b 'Activates when killing an enemy. ATK 3.02%, stacks up to 15, 10 sec' — it.skip for the mechanic (no kills possible), but paired with an ENFORCED inertness assertion: zero atkPct 3.02 buffApply events and no passive-triggered carrier block.

⚑ NOT ASSERTED (outside the input domain): the SR cadence tuple (pullsPerSec / chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 159 are datamine-unreliable per the ALWAYS-⚑ list), so no assertion pins shot COUNT — every proc-rate claim here is expressed as a per-shot gate ratio, not an absolute tick count. Also not asserted: whether the 999% burst is noFb-flagged explicitly vs FB-exempt by cast timing (the counterfactual proves the OUTCOME, not the mechanism), and per-kit hitRate/core magnitude (measured-only).
